responsibility: This header declares the public interface to GCC’s lazy code motion bitmap framework. It exposes the edge-based PRE/LCM entry points, including forward and reverse variants and the shared availability computation routine, so RTL passes such as GCSE-style or mode-placement optimizers can invoke the generic dataflow solver with their own expression/property bitmaps and receive edge insertion and block deletion maps.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/lcm.cc, which implements the LCM/PRE algorithms, this header is limited to declaring the edge-based lazy code motion APIs and shared availability routine for use by RTL optimization passes.
